Controls

WASD move · Space jump, swim up, climb · Shift sneak · Ctrl or double-tap W sprint · Mouse look · LMB attack (hold to mine in Battle Royale) · RMB open chest, hold to eat, drink or draw a bow, throw splash potions, equip armour, place blocks · 1-9 or wheel hotbar · E chest · Q drop · R ready (lobby) · Tab lobby · Esc pause

Resource Packs

Load Java Edition resource packs (.zip) or a Minecraft client .jar you own. They're read on this device only and remembered in this browser. Packs stack: load a full texture source (for example the 1.21 client jar or Programmer Art) first, then the Legacy Console pack for its panorama, bat and sounds.
